title: Trust store v2: issuer public keys and the span each may sign in
description: The keys a receipt verifier already holds (expectrail/receipt.py, docs/verify/receipt-check.js). A key is trusted for a receipt only when the key is not revoked and the receipt's issuedAt is at or after validFrom and, when notAfter is given, before notAfter. A revoked key is refused for every receipt, whatever date it carries. A reader that meets a field it does not know refuses the whole store. Public keys only: a private key never goes in this file. v1 (format expectrail.trust-store/v1) has keys with id, publicKey and an optional note, and no dates.

id.description: The receipt's issuerKeyId. Unique in the store; a new key gets a new id.

publicKey.description: Canonical base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

validFrom.description: RFC 3339 with an offset. Receipts issued before this are refused.

notAfter.description: RFC 3339 with an offset, after validFrom. The key was retired: receipts issued at or after this are refused. Its earlier receipts expire within 7 days of it.

revoked.description: The key may be in someone else's hands. Every receipt it signed is refused.
